caseName: Schriber-Schroth Co. v. Cleveland Trust Co.
caseNameFull: Schriber-Schroth Co. v. Cleveland Trust Co. Aberdeen Motor Supply Co. v. Same and F. E. Rowe Sales Co. v. Same
attorneys: Messrs. Thomas G. Haight, George L. Wilkinson, John H. Bruninga, and John H. Sutherland for petitioners., Messrs. AC. Denison, F. O. Richey, and Wm. C. McCoy for respondents.

opinions.text: The motion for leave to file a second petition for rehearing is granted.' The second petition for. rehearing is granted. The order denying certiorari is vacated and the petition for writs of certiorari is granted.
